_comment: Water-exchange rate constants k_ex (s^-1) at 298.15 K of aqua metal ions, source Helm & Merbach, Chem. Rev. 105, 1923 (2005). Status per row (`verification`): verified_secondary = the k_ex matches a published copy of the review's table (10 rows, checked 2026-10-08, the review itself was not opened); recalled = written from memory and NOT checked. The activation enthalpies and the mechanism labels (Id / Ia / D) are recalled except where a row names `mechanism_source`: Rh3+ and Ir3+ (k_ex, activation enthalpy and the Ia label read from the open table of Cusanelli et al., Chimia 50, 618 (1996), `verified_primary`) and the mechanism labels of Cr3+, V2+, Zn2+ and Fe3+ (open Chimia 51, 97 (1997): a computed assignment that agrees with the experimental trend, not a measurement). Used by engine/src/substitution.rs for the Eigen-Wilkins relation k_f = K_os k_ex.

ions.verification_note: k_ex equals the value of the table in https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Metal_aquo_complex, which cites Helm & Merbach (2005); the review itself is paywalled and was not opened. delta_h_kj and mechanism were not checked.
ions.mechanism_source: Rotzinger, Chimia 51, 97 (1997), text and Fig. 4 (computed mechanism assignment, open access): the text names V(II) and Cr(III) as reacting 'via the Ia mechanism' (was Id, recalled)
